debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to aid troubleshooting

log_path.description: Absolute path to the main log file

max_log_size.description: Maximum size (in megabytes) per log file before rotation

max_log_files.description: Number of rotated log files to retain

monitors.description: List of monitor identifiers (e.g., bus+address strings like 'i2c-3:0x37') to control

default_brightness.description: Global default brightness level (0–100) applied at startup if not overridden

default_contrast.description: Global default contrast level (0–100) applied at startup if not overridden

min_interval.description: Minimum seconds between successive brightness changes (prevents flicker)

auto_save.description: Automatically save current brightness/contrast settings on exit or DDC/CI timeout

monitor_configs.description: Per-monitor custom settings — overrides global defaults

id.description: Unique identifier for the monitor config block

gamma.description: Custom gamma exponent (used only if curve = 'gamma')

min_brightness.description: Lowest allowed brightness for this monitor

max_brightness.description: Highest allowed brightness for this monitor

triggers.description: Events that invoke external commands (e.g., script execution)

command.description: Shell command to execute on trigger (e.g., '/usr/local/bin/log-brightness.sh')
